Derive a simple OS-style ADTTE from ADSL death / last-alive dates

Source: R/standardize.R
derive_mock_adtte.Rd

Used when a local CDISC Pilot checkout has ADSL but no ADTTE, or when a demo needs a second PARAMCD alongside a native TTE dataset.

Usage

derive_mock_adtte(adsl, paramcd = "OS", param = "Overall Survival")

Arguments

adsl

Standardized ADSL with TRTSDT and either DTHDT / DTHFL or LSTALVDT.

paramcd

Parameter code to assign.

param

Parameter label.

Value

An ADTTE-like data frame.
